title: FeCl3/SiO2-catalyzed bis-indolylation of acetals and ketals: a highly atom-economical approach to the selective deprotection of protected carbohydrates
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5523-5534
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07809H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Barnali Das, Kamal Das, Utpal Ch. De, Swapan Majumdar
Herein, we report a general and green protocol for FeCl3/SiO2-catalyzed bis-indolylation of acetals and ketals, which is extended to a 100% atom-economical approach for the deprotection of protected carbohydrates.
